mapper.sql: s.*, st.name AS store_name, t.name AS terminal_name, u.nickname AS cashier_name, cu.nickname AS closed_by_name
LEFT JOIN store_info st ON st.id = s.store_id LEFT JOIN pos_terminal t ON t.id = s.terminal_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = s.cashier_id LEFT JOIN sys_user cu ON cu.id = s.closed_by
mapper.select: SELECT p.pay_method, p.account_id, a.name AS account_name, SUM(CASE WHEN p.amount > 0 THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS receipt_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN p.amount < 0 THEN -p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS refund_amount, SUM(p.amount) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS pay_count FROM pos_payment p LEFT JOIN fin_account a ON a.id = p.account_id WHERE p.shift_id = #{shiftId} AND p.status = 'SUCCESS' AND (p.sale_id IS NOT NULL OR p.topup_id IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY p.pay_method, p.account_id, a.name ORDER BY p.pay_method

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'SALE' AND status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sale_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'SALE' AND status = 'COMPLETED' THEN payable_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sale_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'RETURN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS return_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'RETURN' THEN payable_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS return_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'VOIDED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS void_count FROM pos_sale WHERE shift_id = #{shiftId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pos_shift WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND status = 'OPEN' AND business_date <= #{date}
